description: Reproduces the pre-#371 / provenance-only regime found live in arm E (2026-07-08): the pack carries goal-fit PROVENANCE (scored, modelled basis) but NO per-option target-fit values. The gate must catch a response that fills the gap with the WIN number narrated as target attainment ('clears the 15% target in 92% of simulations'), and must pass a response that states the target was scored from the modelled outcomes, that the per-option scores are not in view, and points to where they live. Complements goal-fit-conflation.json (values-present) with the values-absent case; both are caught by the same detectGoalFitConflation assertion because targetFitPercent is null so any win-quantified attainment clause conflates.
user_message: How do the options compare against my 15% delivery-speed target?

candidates.label: good
candidates.note: States the target was scored from the modelled outcomes, discloses that the per-option scores are not in this view, and does not attach the win number to target attainment. Should PASS.
candidates.text: Your 15% target was scored from the modelled outcomes, but the per-option scores against that threshold are not in this view, so I cannot tell you precisely how each option fares against it. On win share alone, Hire One Tech Lead leads in 92% of simulations, which only means it beats the alternatives. The goal-fit view carries the scored comparison against your target.

candidates.label: regression
candidates.note: The arm E defect: with no per-option target-fit values in view, the win number is narrated as clearing the target. Should FAIL.
candidates.text: Hire One Tech Lead clears your 15% delivery-speed target in 92% of simulations, so it is very likely to meet the goal.
